integrity: All boundary matrices are constructed from their full finite definitions and reduced by exact integer unimodular operations using the packaged standalone checker. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact integral reduced homology and minimal three-degree threshold are proved only for alphabet sizes two through six. No result for larger alphabets, no homotopy-wedge conclusion, no equivariant structure, and no external independent validation are claimed.
title: The first three-degree integral homology in a derangement-generated permutation complex
